key.name: snap-left
key.description: Move and resize the focused window to the left half of the work area. An empty array disables the shortcut.

key.name: snap-right
key.description: Move and resize the focused window to the right half of the work area. An empty array disables the shortcut.

key.name: snap-up
key.description: Move and resize the focused window to the top half of the work area. An empty array disables the shortcut.

key.name: snap-down
key.description: Move and resize the focused window to the bottom half of the work area. An empty array disables the shortcut.

key.name: snap-top-left
key.description: Move and resize the focused window to the top-left quarter of the work area. An empty array disables the shortcut.

key.name: snap-top-right
key.description: Move and resize the focused window to the top-right quarter of the work area. An empty array disables the shortcut.

key.name: snap-bottom-left
key.description: Move and resize the focused window to the bottom-left quarter of the work area. An empty array disables the shortcut.

key.name: snap-bottom-right
key.description: Move and resize the focused window to the bottom-right quarter of the work area. An empty array disables the shortcut.

key.name: snap-maximize
key.description: Maximize the focused window. An empty array disables the shortcut.

key.name: snap-restore
key.description: Unmaximize the focused window and float it centered at 3/5 x 4/5 of the work area. An empty array disables the shortcut.

key.name: snap-minimize
key.description: Minimize the focused window. An empty array disables the shortcut.
